ns2:course.label: Ethnography of Local Cultures
ns2:course.description: Introduction to ethnographic modes of researching culture in human activities, events, organizations, and thinking through participant observation in local settings; focus on the central tasks of ethnographic research (discovery, representation, presentation, justification) through mastery of field notes and various equipment. Same as ANTH 464, and SOC 482. Prerequisite: EPSY 402, ANTH 230, or equivalent work in social sciences.
